As of my last knowledge update in October 2023, I cannot provide real-time financial data, such as current market caps and P/E ratios. However, I can give you an example template that you can fill out with the most recent data for the top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq-100. You would typically obtain this information from a financial news website, a stock market application, or a financial data service. 

Here's an example template:

| Rank | Company Name       | Ticker | Market Cap (Billion $) | P/E Ratio |

| 3    | Alphabet Inc.      | GOOGL  |                         |           |
| 4    | Amazon.com Inc.    | AMZN   |                         |           |
| 5    | Tesla Inc.         | TSLA   |                         |           |
| 6    | Nvidia Corp.       | NVDA   |                         |           |
